final_message: Updated `grammar/precedence.ebnf` so the exponent rule now uses `unary` operands (`exponent = unary '^' unary ;`) instead of bare `atom`, since `unary` is documented at level 70 (higher/tighter-binding) than `exponent` at level 60. The example marker was corrected from `exponent-binds-before-unary` to `unary-binds-before-exponent` to match the stated precedence, while the `unary` rule itself was left unchanged.
